feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence from iteration 0 (score 176): on the s-bend all 20 trials went off track at progress 0.26, and on the slalom at progress 0.10, with about 1 line-loss event per run. Max error sat at the 0.060 m off-track floor while rms error (0.02 to 0.03 m) and steering_oscillation (0.14 to 0.32) stayed low, so the robot was reacting late, not jittering. The 40 mm look-ahead is the likely cause, so moving the sensors to y 0.06 is a sound first change. Narrowing wheel_track to 0.10 m raises turn rate per unit of wheel difference by 1.2x, which can add turn authority but also raises steering gain and oscillation risk. The Integrator therefore reduced kp to 2.5 and raised kd to 0.4 in the controller to compensate; this is a design choice, not a measured result. If the next race shows line_loss_events still near 1 on the s-bend with max_error at the floor, move the sensors further ahead to y 0.07 (within the 0.08 limit) while keeping x positions and the 12 mm footprint. If steering_oscillation rises well above the baseline range (about 0.35 or more) with the narrower track, try an intermediate wheel_track of 0.11 before going back to 0.12. If the robot now finishes the oval with low error, change speed (wheel_radius or base_speed) rather than geometry.
requested_changes: If the next race still shows about 1 line-loss event per run on the s-bend with max_error at the 0.06 m floor, move all five sensors to y 0.07 (keeping x positions and sensor_size 0.012), since iteration 0 showed the 0.04 m look-ahead lost the line on every s-bend trial.

If steering_oscillation rises well above the baseline range (about 0.35 or more) on the oval or s-bend, set wheel_track to 0.11 as a middle value, since the narrower 0.10 m track raises turn-rate gain by 1.2x and the baseline oscillation was low (0.14 to 0.32).

If the robot finishes the oval with low rms error but completion_time is still above 3 s (the baseline oval finishers averaged 1.87 s, so this is unlikely), change wheel_radius to 0.035 for more ground speed rather than changing the sensor layout.
